e.title: **一次取回**全部法律清单**，**然后在**本地**筛出**与保险有关的那部分****：日本 **e-Gov 法令 API**（`elaws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1`）——**⭐ 本次实测**返回 **2,794,325 字节**、**逐字含 **`<LawId>321CONSTITUTION</LawId><LawName>日本国憲法</LawName>`**；**⭐ 本地解析**得法律 **9,012 部**，**其中**名称含「**保険**」的 **262 部****；**⭐ 逐字含 **`407AC0000000105`**「**保険業法**」与 **`323AC0000000193`**「**損害保険料率算出団体に関する法律**」**（**⭐ 即**非寿险**费率计算团体**的**法定依据**）**；**⚠️ 而**关键字检索路径**本次**返回 **404****
e.title_en: Fetching the entire law list in one request and then filtering the insurance-related part locally: a government legal database interface that returned a file of about two point eight megabytes naming the constitution as its first entry, from which nine thousand and twelve laws could be parsed locally with two hundred and sixty-two carrying the word for insurance in their names, including the insurance business act and the act on non-life insurance rate calculating organisations.
e.title_hk: **一次取回**全部法律清單**，**然後在**本地**篩出**與保險有關的那部分****：日本 **e-Gov 法令 API**（`elaws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1`）——**⭐ 本次實測**返回 **2,794,325 位元組**、**逐字含 `<LawId>321CONSTITUTION</LawId><LawName>日本国憲法</LawName>`**；**⭐ 本地解析**得法律 **9,012 部**，**其中**名稱含「**保険**」的 **262 部****；**⭐ 逐字含 `407AC0000000105`「**保険業法**」與 `323AC0000000193`「**損害保険料率算出団体に関する法律**」**；**⚠️ 而**關鍵字檢索路徑**本次返回 404****
e.summary: **e-Gov 法令 API**（日本政府法令数据库的接口，`elaws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1`）**是一个**把**日本现行法令清单**做成**一次可取回的数据**的接口****——**本次实测**：**须**跟随一次重定向**（**先 **301**、**再 **200**）**，**返回 **2,794,325 字节**（**约 **2.79 MB**）的 **XML****，**逐字含 **`0`** 与 **`321CONSTITUTION日本国憲法`****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**法规文本的可编程接口**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 一次请求取回 **9,012 部法律的清单****（**⭐ 本次**在**本地解析 **`LawId` 与 **`LawName` 配对后计数**）**——**⭐ 即**调用者**不必**逐部**查询**，**而**可以**把**整个清单**拿下来**在**本地**筛选**；**② **⭐ 名称含「**保険**」（**保险）的法律共 **262 部****——**⭐ 本次**逐字取到**的例子含**：**`407AC0000000105`**「**保険業法**」**（**保险业法）**、**`323AC0000000193`**「**損害保険料率算出団体に関する法律**」**（**非寿险**费率计算团体**法）**、**`211AC0000000070`**「**健康保険法**」**、**`322AC0000000050`**「**労働者災害補償保険法**」**、**`322AC0000000185`**「**農業保険法**」**、**`312AC0000000025`**「**森林保険法**」**、**`314AC0000000073`**「**船員保険法**」**与**`323AC0000000129`**「**社会保険診療報酬支払基金法**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为**其中**「**損害保険料率算出団体**」**一部**最值得 RIAA 注意**：**⭐ 即**非寿险**费率计算团体**的**法定地位**是**有**专门法律**的**（**⭐ 对**费率**共用的**治理问题**，**这**是一个**可直接引用的**制度样本**）**；**③ **⭐ 标识**（**`LawId`）**自带**年代与**编号信息****——**⭐ 例如 **`407AC0000000105`** 与 **`323AC0000000193`** 的**前三位**分别对应**不同**年号**、**后段**对应**法律编号**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**这一结构**，**不逐位**解释**其编码规则**）**；**④ **⚠️ 而**本次**试错的**关键字检索路径**（`/api/1/keyword?keyword=保険`）**返回 **404****——**⭐ 本词条**如实注明**这**是**本条的**路径错误**，**不构成**对**该 API**是否存在**关键字检索**的判断**。**⚠️ 本次**只做**只读取用**。
e.summary_hk: **e-Gov 法令 API**（日本政府法令數據庫的介面，`elaws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1`）**是一個**把**日本現行法令清單**做成**一次可取回的數據**的介面****——**本次實測**：**須跟隨一次重定向**（**先 301、**再 200**）**，**返回 2,794,325 位元組（**約 2.79 MB**）的 XML**，**逐字含 `0` 與 `321CONSTITUTION日本国憲法`**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**法規文本的可編程介面**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 一次請求取回 9,012 部法律的清單****（**本地解析 LawId 與 LawName 配對後計數**）**——**⭐ 即**可把整個清單拿下來在本地篩選**；**② **⭐ 名稱含「**保険**」的法律共 262 部****——**逐字取到 `407AC0000000105`「**保険業法**」、`323AC0000000193`「**損害保険料率算出団体に関する法律**」、`211AC0000000070`「**健康保険法**」、`322AC0000000050`「**労働者災害補償保険法**」、`322AC0000000185`「**農業保険法**」、`312AC0000000025`「**森林保険法**」、`314AC0000000073`「**船員保険法**」與 `323AC0000000129`「**社会保険診療報酬支払基金法**」**——**⭐ 其中損害保険料率算出団体一部最值得注意**：**⭐ 即**非壽險費率計算團體的法定地位是有專門法律的**；**③ **⭐ 標識 `LawId` 自帶年代與編號資訊**；**④ **⚠️ 本次試錯的關鍵字檢索路徑返回 404**——**⭐ 這是本條的路徑錯誤**，**不構成對該 API 是否有關鍵字檢索的判斷**。**⚠️ 本次**只做只讀取用**。
e.summary_en: This interface **makes the list of current Japanese statutes retrievable in one request**, and was measured this round as requiring one redirect to follow, then returning a file of about two point eight megabytes whose body begins with a successful result code and names the constitution as its first entry. **This entry belongs to the round theme of programmable interfaces to legal text.** **Four things are worth reading: a single request yields a list of nine thousand and twelve laws, counted locally by pairing each law identifier with its name, so a caller does not have to query law by law but can take the whole list and filter it locally; two hundred and sixty-two of those names contain the word for insurance, including the insurance business act, the act on non-life insurance rate calculating organisations, the health insurance act, the workers accident compensation insurance act, the agricultural insurance act, the forest insurance act, the mariners insurance act and the social insurance medical fee payment fund act, and among them the act on rate calculating organisations deserves particular attention because the legal standing of a non-life rate-making body rests on dedicated legislation, which is a citable institutional model for questions about shared rate-making governance; the identifier scheme itself carries era and number information; and a keyword search path tried this round returned not found, which this entry records as its own mistaken path rather than as a judgement about the interface.** **Only read-only fetches were made this round.**
e.body: **e-Gov 法令 API**（日本政府法令数据库的接口，`elaws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1`）**是一个**把**日本现行法令清单**做成**一次可取回的数据**的接口****——**本次实测**：**须**跟随一次重定向**（**先 **301**、**再 **200**）**，**返回 **2,794,325 字节**（**约 **2.79 MB**）的 **XML****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**法规文本的可编程接口**」**。 **可核实信息（均本次只读取用实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一次请求取回**全部法律清单，**而**调用者**可以**在本地筛选****——**⭐ 本次实测**其返回体**逐字以** `01`** 开头**，**随后**逐字为 **`321CONSTITUTION日本国憲法`****；**⭐ 本次**在本地**按 **`LawId` 与 **`LawName` **配对**计数**，**得 **9,012 部**法律**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**把**整个清单**拿下来**、**在**本地**筛选**」**与**「**逐部**查询**」**是**两种**很不同的**工作方式**——**⭐ 前者**在**网络不稳定**或**有频率限制**时**更稳妥**，**且**便于**做**统计分析**（**⭐ 本次**的 **262 部**就是**这样数出来的**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 名称含「**保険**」的法律共 **262 部**，**而**其中一部**对 RIAA 特别值得注意****——**⭐ 本次逐字取到的例子含**：**`407AC0000000105`**「**保険業法**」**（**保险业法）**、**`323AC0000000193`**「**損害保険料率算出団体に関する法律**」**（**非寿险**费率计算团体**法）**、**`211AC0000000070`**「**健康保険法**」**、**`322AC0000000050`**「**労働者災害補償保険法**」**（**工伤保险）**、**`322AC0000000185`**「**農業保険法**」**、**`312AC0000000025`**「**森林保険法**」**、**`314AC0000000073`**「**船員保険法**」**与**`323AC0000000129`**「**社会保険診療報酬支払基金法**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**損害保険料率算出団体**」**这一部**最值得 RIAA 注意**：**⭐ 即**在**一个**成熟市场**里**，「**多家公司共用**费率与**统计**」**这件事**是**有**专门法律**来**规定其**组织形式与**义务**的**——**⭐ 对**讨论**费率**共用、**统计**共用与**治理**边界**的**学生**而言**，**这**是一个**可直接引用的**制度样本**（**⭐ 本条**只记录**该法律**在**清单中的**存在与其**名称**，**未取**其**条文**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 标识**（**`LawId`）**自带**年代与**编号信息****——**⭐ 本次逐字见到的**标识**形如 **`321CONSTITUTION`**（**宪法）与 **`407AC0000000105`**、**`323AC0000000193`**、**`312AC0000000025`**、**`314AC0000000073`** 等****；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 前三位**对应**不同**年号**、**后段**对应**法律编号**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**这一结构**，**不逐位**解释**编码规则**，**也**未核实**其**官方定义**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 一处**本次的**路径错误**如实记录****——**⭐ 本次**为**做关键字检索**，**尝试了 **`/api/1/keyword?keyword=保険&limit=5`**，**返回 **404****（**网页错误页**，**720 字节**）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实注明**：**这**是**本条作者**对**端点路径的**猜测错误**，**不构成**对**该 API**是否**提供**关键字检索**的判断**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[japan-fsa-statistics]]、**[[japan-giro]] 与**[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]] 覆盖**日本的**监管与**行业统计**、**[[us-federal-register-api]]、**[[uk-legislation-api]] 与**[[australia-legislation-api]] 覆盖**美英澳三国的**法规接口**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**一次取回**全国法律清单**、**并**可**在本地**筛出**保险相关法律**的**日语法令接口**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。 **对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **先看**能不能**一次取回全集**（**⭐ 本条**为 **9,012 部**）**，**再**考虑**逐条查询**；**② **筛选**要**落在**可核对的关键词上**（**本条**为**名称含「**保険」**）**；**③ **制度设计**可以**通过**「**有没有专门法律**」**来**确认**（**本条**为**费率计算团体**）**；**④ **试错路径**要**如实记为**自己的错误**，**不要**当成**对方的能力缺失**。 **⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有**取用**任何**法律的**正文**（**⭐ 只取到**清单层的 **`LawId` 与 **`LawName`**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何条文内容**、**不主张**其**现行有效性**、**也**不主张**本文中**任何法律名称的**中文译名**是**官方译名**（**⭐ 中文译名**为**本词条**所加**）**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**该接口返回的**清单 XML**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**关键字检索**是否存在**及其**正确路径**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**使用条款与**频率限制**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**「**名称含保険」**是否**等同于**「**与保险业务相关」**——**⭐ 例如**健康保险**与**工伤保险**属**社会保障**，**与**商业保险**不同**（**⭐ 本条**在正文中**已如实举出**这两类**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该接口**返回的是**日本法令清单**，**不构成**法律意见**。 ## 同类工具 [[raidiam-open-insurance-conformance]]、[[hokus-fee-catalog]]、[[irs-actuarial-tables-processor]]

e.body_en:
This interface **makes the list of current Japanese statutes retrievable in one request**, measured this round as requiring one redirect to follow and then returning a file of about two point eight megabytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of programmable interfaces to legal text.**

**Verified information, all from read-only fetches made this round**: **first, one request returns the whole list of laws, and the caller can filter it locally.** The body begins with a successful result code inside an application data element and then names the constitution as its first entry, pairing each law identifier with its name; counting those pairs locally yields nine thousand and twelve laws. **Taking the whole list and filtering locally is a different way of working from querying law by law, and it is steadier where the network is unreliable or rate limits apply, as well as being easier to analyse, which is how the count below was obtained.** **Second, two hundred and sixty-two of those names contain the word for insurance, and one of them deserves particular attention for this project.** The examples retrieved include the insurance business act, the act on non-life insurance rate calculating organisations, the health insurance act, the workers accident compensation insurance act, the agricultural insurance act, the forest insurance act, the mariners insurance act and the social insurance medical fee payment fund act. **The act on rate calculating organisations matters most here: in a mature market the sharing of rates and statistics among competing companies rests on dedicated legislation that sets out the body form and its obligations, which is a citable institutional model for discussions about shared rate-making, shared statistics and the boundary of governance, and this entry records only that the act appears in the list with that name, not its provisions.** **Third, the identifier scheme itself carries era and number information**, with forms seen here including a plain word identifier for the constitution and several numeric identifiers. **This entry records the structure without interpreting the encoding digit by digit and without verifying its official definition.** **Fourth, one path error made this round is recorded plainly**: a keyword search path returned not found with a small error page, **and this entry notes that this was the author mistaken guess at an endpoint rather than a judgement about whether the interface offers keyword search at all.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover Japanese supervisory and industry statistics, and the North American, British and Australian legal interfaces collected alongside this one, **while this entry supplies a Japanese statute interface whose whole law list can be fetched once and filtered locally for insurance-related laws. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: check first whether the full set can be fetched in one call, here nine thousand laws, before designing per-item queries; filter on a checkable keyword, here the word for insurance in the name; confirm institutional design by asking whether dedicated legislation exists, as the rate calculating organisations act shows; and record a mistaken path as one own error rather than as a missing capability on the other side.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no statute text was retrieved**, only identifiers and names at the list level, **so no claim is made about the content of any provision, about current validity, or that any Chinese rendering of a law name here is an official translation, those renderings being added by this entry**. **Second, only the list XML returned by the interface was read.** **Third, whether keyword search exists and what its correct path is were not verified. Fourth, its terms of use and rate limits were not verified.
